package.name: Tutor
package.description: An agent teaches FreeCAD in your own window: it explains a control, points at it, does a job step by step while saying why, or guides you through it and checks each step. It never moves the cursor or takes over the screen. Lessons are data files. Needs Agent Link for FreeCAD. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

other.name: Tutor
other.description: The lesson engine, its checks and the starter lessons, loaded by Agent Link for FreeCAD. Not a workbench.
